lines: Your local agents are smaller than cloud ones, so expect slower work on long tasks.
Starnet is a living pixel-art station for real AI agents that do actual work.
The front end talks to a local runtime via localhost events. An explicit leash limits all away actions before they happen.
Paste an OpenRouter key or sign in with Anthropic, OpenAI, Google accounts to wire agents to Telegram, Discord, Slack.
An 8B model needs about 10 G for context, but you can run free with Ollama.
The frontend is vanilla JavaScript and runs on Node 22 which matches CI.
You can import an agent's full persona, instructions, memory, and other data directly from OpenClaw or Hermes.
Download Windows exe, macOS dmg files or run from source with Git.
StarNet is MIT licensed and open source, trusted to run your crew locally.
Install Node and run desktop build or pull a local model to start.
Save this for a crew member who needs to work locally.
Start your own AI crew with Starnet.
